### Fixes
- Editor tooltips (autocomplete and the problem popover) now attach to the window you're working in when the editor has no explicit root, instead of always the main window. This matters in popout windows.

### Maintenance
- Updated the development toolchain: ESLint 10, eslint-plugin-obsidianmd 0.6, TypeScript 6 (now type-checked in strict mode), Vitest 5, Stylelint 18, and the CodeMirror and Lezer packages to their latest patch releases. nanoid moves to 6.
- The release and Obsidian-build workflows now run on Node 22 with current GitHub Actions.
- `main.js` grows by about 1.2 KB (0.6 KB gzipped), from the updated Lezer parsers.

### Validation
- 1,331 automated tests pass, plus lint, browser typechecking and the production build. The new build passed the end-to-end check in Obsidian 1.15.1.
- Mobile was not tested on a device.
